All sources referenced in the n8n research. Numbered sequentially. Each entry
includes the URL, access date, source tier, and specific data extracted.

## Source Quality Tiers

- **Tier 1:** Peer-reviewed papers, government/institutional reports
- **Tier 2:** Official documentation, manufacturer specs, established reference sites
- **Tier 3:** Industry blogs, conference talks, well-known practitioners
- **Tier 4:** Forums, personal blogs, community discussions

**[1]** Wikipedia — n8n
URL: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/N8n
Accessed: 2026-03-30 | Tier 2
Data: Founded 2019 by Jan Oberhauser in Berlin. Funding: Seed $1.5M (March 2020, Sequoia/firstminute), Series A $12M (April 2021, Felicis), Series B €55M (March 2025, Highland Europe), Series C $180M (October 2025, Accel/Sequoia/NVentures/Meritech). Post-Series C valuation $2.5B. Licensing changed from Apache 2.0 + Commons Clause to Sustainable Use License in March 2022. 350+ integrations as of December 2025.

**[2]** n8n Official Documentation — Advanced AI
URL: https://docs.n8n.io/advanced-ai/
Accessed: 2026-03-30 | Tier 2
Data: AI root nodes (AI Agent with 6 types, Basic LLM Chain, Q&A Chain, Summarization Chain, Information Extractor, Text Classifier, Sentiment Analysis, LangChain Code). LLM providers: Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Cohere, DeepSeek, Google Gemini, Groq, Mistral, Ollama, OpenAI, xAI Grok. Vector stores: Azure AI Search, In-Memory, Milvus, MongoDB Atlas, PGVector, Chroma, Pinecone, Qdrant, Redis, Supabase, Weaviate, Zep. Memory nodes: Chat Memory Manager, Simple Memory, Motorhead, MongoDB, Redis, Postgres, Xata, Zep.

**[3]** Jimmy Song — n8n Deep Dive (2026)
URL: https://jimmysong.io/blog/n8n-deep-dive/
Accessed: 2026-03-30 | Tier 3
Data: Architecture layers: Client → Presentation (Vue 3 + Pinia) → API (Express.js REST + WebSocket) → Business Logic → Execution → Data Access (TypeORM) → Node Ecosystem. Two execution modes: default (main process) and queue (Redis workers). Plugin styles: declarative (JSON) and programmatic (TypeScript). Resource requirements: 2-core CPU and 4GB RAM for most cases. Limitations: single-process bottleneck, unsuitable for ultra-high-frequency/low-latency.

**[4]** n8n Blog — Multi-Agent Systems: Frameworks & Tutorial
URL: https://blog.n8n.io/multi-agent-systems/
Accessed: 2026-03-30 | Tier 2
Data: Three patterns: hierarchical (supervisor + sub-agents), sequential handoff, parallel execution. AI Agent Tool node provides own system prompt, LLM, memory. Sub-workflows as tools reduce execution overhead. Default is sequential; use Execute sub-workflow or HTTP Request for parallel. 1000+ integrations and MCP support.

**[5]** n8n Blog — AI Agentic Workflows: Practical Guide
URL: https://blog.n8n.io/ai-agentic-workflows/
Accessed: 2026-03-30 | Tier 2
Data: Four patterns: chained requests, single agent, multi-agent with gatekeeper, multi-agent teams. $fromAI() expression for parameter definition. Stack: OpenAI/Anthropic/Groq/local + vector DBs + function-calling + LangChain. Distinguishes traditional automation, AI-enhanced, and AI agentic workflows.

**[6]** n8n Blog — 15 Best Practices for Deploying AI Agents in Production
URL: https://blog.n8n.io/best-practices-for-deploying-ai-agents-in-production/
Accessed: 2026-03-30 | Tier 2
Data: Exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s) with jitter, 3-5 retry attempts. Canary deployments with 5% traffic. Rollback target <5 minutes. Monitor human intervention frequency. Schema enforcement for sub-workflows. Dev/staging/production separation. Prompt injection guards: input validation, strict system prompts, output filtering.

**[7]** Hatchworks — Multi-Agent Solutions in n8n
URL: https://hatchworks.com/blog/ai-agents/multi-agent-solutions-in-n8n/
Accessed: 2026-03-30 | Tier 3
Data: Two primary patterns: routing by branch (text classifier → Switch → sub-workflows) and orchestrator agent (AI Agent Tool node). Real-world examples: email support with human approval, personal productivity assistant (email/task/calendar agents). QA validator agents check hallucinations. Single Responsibility Principle per agent. JSON workflows in Git for version control.

**[8]** ZenML Blog — n8n vs Temporal
URL: https://www.zenml.io/blog/n8n-vs-temporal
Accessed: 2026-03-30 | Tier 3
Data: n8n queue-based (main + workers + PostgreSQL + Redis), Temporal microservices (Frontend/History/Matching/Worker via gRPC). Temporal: auto state reconstruction, 51,200 events/execution limit. n8n: 400+ built-in + ~5,800 community nodes. Pricing: n8n $24/month cloud, Temporal $100/month cloud. n8n for business automation, Temporal for transactional integrity.

**[9]** Northflank — How to Self-Host n8n
URL: https://northflank.com/blog/how-to-self-host-n8n-setup-architecture-and-pricing-guide
Accessed: 2026-03-30 | Tier 3
Data: Basic setup: single deployment + PostgreSQL. Advanced: UI/API + workers + PostgreSQL + Redis. Image: docker.n8n.io/n8nio/n8n:latest. Port 5678. N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY minimum 32 chars hex. EXECUTIONS_MODE=queue for workers. Self-hosted $5-10/month infrastructure, cloud $24/month for 2,500 executions.
